description: Discover Ads Insights fields by search, group or ids. Without filters, returns a compact group index and recommended fields. Add accountId to discover custom conversions. Breakdown IDs must be requested through ads_query_insights.breakdowns, not fields. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

accountId.description: Optional account for custom conversion definitions. Omit for static discovery without account access.

group.description: Optional exact catalog group such as delivery, conversions, video, identity, breakdown, or date.

ids.description: Exact field IDs whose full entries to return.

kind.description: Optional catalog kind. Use breakdown to discover values for query.breakdowns, not query.fields.

limit.description: Maximum catalog entries to return in this offset-based page.

offset.description: Zero-based catalog offset for the next field-catalog page.

recommended.description: When true, return only catalog entries recommended for common reporting queries.

search.description: Optional text matched against supported field IDs, labels, kinds, and groups.

name: ads_list_insight_fields
title: List Insight Fields
